mechanics.claim: Trample generates a stack only when its persistent tick damages at least one enemy champion.
mechanics.quote: Each time this damages at least one enemy champion, he generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Trample''

mechanics.claim: At 5 stacks, Alistar's next basic attack on-hit against a champion consumes the stacks to deal bonus magic damage and stun.
mechanics.quote: '''Alistar's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-hit}} against a {{tip|champion}} within 6 seconds ends ''Trample's'' effects to deal {{as|{{pplevel|20 to 275}} '''bonus''' magic damage}}

mechanics.claim: The tick damage is persistent area damage while the empowered attack's bonus damage is proc damage.
mechanics.quote: ''Trample'' deals {{tip|persistent area damage}} damage around '''Alistar''', while the bonus damage on the resulting attack is {{tip|proc damage}}.

mechanics.claim: The stun and bonus damage are blocked by spell shields but the base attack damage is not.
mechanics.quote: The {{tip|stun}} and '''bonus''' damage are blocked by {{tip|spell shield|spell shields}} but the base attack damage is not.

mechanics.claim: The empowered on-hit effect is consumed if the triggering attack is blocked, but not if it is dodged or missed while Alistar is blinded.
mechanics.quote: The on-hit effect is consumed if the attack {{tip|blocked}}, but not if it is {{tip|dodged}} or missed while '''Alistar''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}.

mechanics.claim: The bonus damage and stun can be applied by Guinsoo's Rageblade's Phantom Hit if the triggering attack did not apply them, but not a second time if it already did.
mechanics.quote: The bonus damage and stun can be applied by {{iis|Guinsoo's Rageblade}} Phantom Hit if the triggering attack did not.
